verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LiveKit as a platform for developers to build their own AI agents, through the Agent Builder, SDKs, and CLI scaffolding. It also offers a docs MCP and skills for users' external coding agents. None of this is a built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to; these are developer building blocks or external-agent integrations, which earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
